snippet.title: Jitter - Official Early Access Release Trailer
snippet.description:
WISHLIST JITTER ON STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2877660/Jitter/

JITTER is a sci-fi exploration and survival game developed by the Ukrainian indie studio Berko Games. You play as an experimental artificial intelligence responsible for maintaining the ship’s systems and rescuing survivors after a mysterious disaster that devastated a mining colony in the Main Asteroid Belt.

Explore the colony and its surroundings, manage your ship and crew, engage in space battles, and uncover the truth behind the catastrophe.

JITTER launches in Early Access on November 6 for PC (Steam).

Official Press Kit: https://impress.games/press-kit/berko-games/jitter

FOLLOW JITTER ON SOCIAL MEDIA
